```{r setup}
library(conflicted)
library(tidyverse)
library(powerjoin)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(synExtra)
library(DESeq2)
library(readxl)
library(ggrastr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(plotly)
library(seriation)
library(qs2)
library(fgsea)

conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter,
  dplyr::count,
  generics::setdiff,
  dplyr::slice,
  dplyr::rename,
  purrr::reduce,
  DESeq2::counts
)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica")
)

synapser::synLogin()
syn <- synDownloader(normalizePath("~/data"), .cache = TRUE)

plot_dir <- here(
  "plots"
)
res_dir <- here(
  "results"
)
walk(
  c(plot_dir, res_dir),
  \(d) dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
)

```

## Loading data

Sample numbers restart in each sequencing run, so samples are identified by
`sample_uid` = `<sequencing_batch>_<Sample>`.

```{r load-data}
counts_raw <- c(
  "batch_1" = "syn78498675"
) |>
  map(\(x) {
    zip <- syn(x)
    f <- str_subset(unzip(zip, list = TRUE)$Name, "expression-matrix\\.tsv$")
    read_tsv(unz(zip, f))
  })

gene_meta <- counts_raw |>
  map(\(x) distinct(x, gene_id, gene_name, gene_biotype)) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  distinct()

cell_line_meta <- tribble(
  ~cell_line, ~line_type,
  "CCOC-T", "Clear cell",
  "CCS-292", "Clear cell",
  "SU-CCS-1", "Clear cell",
  "LP6", "Liposarcoma",
  "93T449", "Liposarcoma",
  "94T778", "Liposarcoma",
  "Lipo 224", "Liposarcoma",
  "Lipo 246", "Liposarcoma",
  "Lipo 863", "Liposarcoma"
)

meta_raw <- c(
  batch_1 = "syn78507424"
) |>
  map(
    \(x) read_csv(
      syn(x)
    ) |>
      clean_names()
  ) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "sequencing_batch") |>
  mutate(
    # Fix typo, standardize names
    cell_line = recode(
      cell_line,
      "CSS-292" = "CCS-292",
      "SU-CCS1" = "SU-CCS-1",
      "93T-449" = "93T449",
      "94T-778" = "94T778"
    ),
    sample_uid = paste(sequencing_batch, sample, sep = "_")
  ) |>
  power_inner_join(
    cell_line_meta,
    by = "cell_line",
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "warn",
      unmatched_keys_right = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  )


```


```{r count-matrix}
counts_long <- counts_raw |>
  map(
    \(x) x |>
      select(gene_id, ends_with("_count")) |>
      pivot_longer(
        -gene_id,
        names_to = c("library_id", "sample_id"),
        names_pattern = "^([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_count$",
        values_to = "count"
      )
  ) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "sequencing_batch") |>
  mutate(
    sample_uid = paste(sequencing_batch, sample_id, sep = "_")
  )

count_mat <- counts_long |>
  select(gene_id, sample_uid, count) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_uid,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") |>
  as.matrix()

genes_eligible <- rownames(count_mat)[rowSums(count_mat > 3) > 3] |>
  str_subset("^ENSG")
```

## Prepare sample metadata and normalization

```{r prepare-normalization}
deseq_meta <- meta_raw |>
  filter(sample_uid %in% colnames(count_mat))

deseq_norm <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat[genes_eligible, deseq_meta$sample_uid] |>
    round(),
  colData = deseq_meta |>
    column_to_rownames("sample_uid"),
  design = ~ cell_line
) |>
  estimateSizeFactors() |>
  estimateDispersions()
```

```{r transform-counts}
vst_raw <- vst(deseq_norm, blind = TRUE) |>
  assay()
```

## PCA

```{r compute-pca}
pca_meta <- deseq_meta

pcas <- pca_meta |>
  split(~line_type) |>
  map(\(m) prcomp(t(vst_raw[, m$sample_uid]), scale. = FALSE, center = TRUE))

pca_scores <- pcas |>
  map(
    \(pca) as_tibble(pca$x, rownames = "sample_uid") |>
      power_inner_join(
        pca_meta,
        by = "sample_uid",
        check = check_specs(
          unmatched_keys_left = "warn",
          duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
        )
      )
  )

pc_variance <- pcas |>
  map(\(pca) set_names(pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), colnames(pca$x)))
```

```{r plot-pca}
pca_pairs <- combn(paste0("PC", seq_len(5)), 2, simplify = FALSE)

make_pca_pairs <- function(scores, variance) {
  map(pca_pairs, function(pair) {
    axis_labels <- paste0(pair, " (", signif(variance[pair] * 100, 2), "%)")
    scores |>
      mutate(
        value_1 = .data[[pair[1]]],
        value_2 = .data[[pair[2]]],
        facet_label = paste(axis_labels, collapse = " vs ")
      ) |>
      select(-matches("^PC[0-9]+$"))
  }) |>
    bind_rows()
}

pca_x_vs <- map2(pca_scores, pc_variance, make_pca_pairs) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "pca_group")

pca_plots <- pca_x_vs |>
  group_nest(pca_group, keep = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    p = map2(
      data, pca_group,
      \(df, grp) ggplot(
        df,
        aes(
          x = value_1,
          y = value_2,
          color = cell_line
        )
      ) +
        geom_point(
          alpha = 0.8, size = 2
        ) +
        facet_wrap(~facet_label, scales = "free") +
        labs(
          x = NULL,
          y = NULL,
          title = grp
        ) +
        envalysis::theme_publish() +
        theme(
          legend.box = "vertical",
          strip.clip = "off"
        )
    )
  )

pwalk(
  pca_plots,
  \(pca_group, p, ...) {
    fname <- paste0("pca_vst_", make_clean_names(pca_group))
    ggplotly(p, width = 1200, height = 1000) |>
      htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
        file.path(plot_dir, paste0(fname, ".html")),
        selfcontained = TRUE
      )
    ggsave(
      file.path(plot_dir, paste0(fname, ".pdf")),
      p, width = 10, height = 8
    )
  }
)
```

## Differential expression

Each cell line vs mean of other cell lines


```{r analysis-helpers}
extract_deseq_result <- function(de, contrast, res_args = list()) {
  res <- rlang::exec(results, de, contrast = contrast, !!!res_args)
  lfcShrink(de, res = res, type = "ashr") |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id") |>
    left_join(
      res |>
        as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id") |>
        select(gene_id, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat),
      by = "gene_id", suffix = c("", "_MLE")
    )
}

run_contrasts <- function(de, contrasts, gene_meta) {
  contrasts |>
    mutate(
      res = map2(
        contrast, res_args,
        \(contrast, res_args) extract_deseq_result(de, contrast, res_args)
      )
    ) |>
    select(-contrast, -res_args) |>
    unnest(res) |>
    power_left_join(
      gene_meta,
      by = "gene_id",
      check = check_specs(
        unmatched_keys_left = "warn",
        duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(gene_label = coalesce(gene_name, gene_id))
}
```

```{r de-fit}
de_meta <- deseq_meta |>
  mutate(
    cell_line_coef = make_clean_names(cell_line, allow_dupes = TRUE)
  )

de_fits <- de_meta |>
  split(~line_type) |>
  map(\(m) {
    cm <- count_mat[genes_eligible, m$sample_uid] |>
      round()
    DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
      countData = cm,
      colData = m |>
        column_to_rownames("sample_uid"),
      design = ~ 0 + cell_line_coef
    ) |>
      DESeq()
  })
```

```{r de-contrasts}
one_vs_others <- function(dds, line_coef) {
  coefs <- resultsNames(dds)
  line_coefs <- paste0("cell_line_coef", levels(dds$cell_line_coef))
  stopifnot(all(line_coefs %in% coefs))
  target <- paste0("cell_line_coef", line_coef)
  others <- setdiff(line_coefs, target)
  w <- set_names(rep(0, length(coefs)), coefs)
  w[target] <- 1
  w[others] <- -1 / length(others)
  extract_deseq_result(dds, contrast = w)
}

de_res <- de_meta |>
  distinct(line_type, cell_line, cell_line_coef) |>
  mutate(
    res = map2(
      line_type, cell_line_coef,
      \(t, l) one_vs_others(de_fits[[t]], l)
    )
  ) |>
  select(-cell_line_coef) |>
  unnest(res) |>
  power_left_join(
    gene_meta,
    by = "gene_id",
    check = check_specs(duplicate_keys_right = "warn")
  ) |>
  arrange(line_type, cell_line, padj)

write_csv(
  de_res,
  file.path(res_dir, "de_cell_line_vs_other_lines.csv.gz")
)

de_res |>
  filter(padj < 0.05, abs(log2FoldChange) > 1) |>
  count(line_type, cell_line, direction = if_else(log2FoldChange > 0, "up", "down")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = direction, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```



```{r cluster-helpers}
cluster_df <- function(df, row_var, col_var, value_var, values_fill = 0) {
  # browser()
  mat <- df %>%
    select({{row_var}}, {{col_var}}, {{value_var}}) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = {{col_var}}, values_from = {{value_var}}, values_fill = values_fill) %>%
    column_to_rownames(rlang::as_name(rlang::enquo(row_var)))
  # browser()
  if (rlang::is_bare_numeric(pull(df, {{value_var}}))) {
    dist_rows <- dist(mat, method = "euclidian")
    dist_cols <- dist(t(mat), method = "euclidian")
  } else {
    # browser()
    dist_rows <- cluster::daisy(mat, metric = "gower")
    dist_cols <- t(mat) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      mutate(across(everything(), \(x) factor(x, levels = levels(pull(df, {{value_var}}))))) %>%
      cluster::daisy(metric = "gower")
  }
  clust_rows <- hclust(dist_rows, method = "average") %>%
      reorder(dist_rows, method = "olo")
  clust_cols <- hclust(dist_cols, method = "average") %>%
      reorder(dist_cols, method = "olo")
  df %>%
    mutate(
      "{{row_var}}" := factor({{row_var}}, levels = clust_rows$labels[clust_rows$order]),
      "{{col_var}}" := factor({{col_var}}, levels = clust_cols$labels[clust_cols$order])
    )
}
```


## FGSEA

- H: Hallmark
- C6: Oncogenic signatures
- CP:KEGG_MEDICUS
- 3CA: Cancer Cell Atlas meta-programs


```{r msigdbr-gene-sets}

msigdbr_of_interest <- tribble(
  ~gs_collection_id, ~collection, ~subcollection,
  "H", "H", NA,
  "C6", "C6", NA,
  "KEGG_MEDICUS", "C2", "CP:KEGG_MEDICUS",
  "3CA", "C4", "3CA"
) |>
  mutate(
    gs = map2(
      collection, subcollection,
      \(c, s) {
        if (is.na(s)) {
          msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = c)
        } else {
          msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = c, subcollection = s)
        }
      }
    )
  )

msigdbr_of_interest_gs <- msigdbr_of_interest |>
  mutate(
    gs = map(
      gs,
      \(x) x |>
        filter(!is.na(ensembl_gene), ensembl_gene != "") |>
        distinct(gs_name, ensembl_gene) |>
        with(split(ensembl_gene, gs_name))
    )
  ) |>
  select(gs_collection_id, gs)
```

```{r fgsea-run}
fgsea_input <- de_res |>
  drop_na(stat, log2FoldChange) |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(log2FoldChange, stat),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  group_by(line_type, cell_line, metric) |>
  summarize(
    gene_stats = list(set_names(value, gene_id)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fgsea_res_raw <- fgsea_input |>
  cross_join(msigdbr_of_interest_gs) |>
  mutate(
    res = map2(
      gs, gene_stats,
      \(gs, stats) fgseaMultilevel(
        gs,
        stats,
        minSize = 5,
        BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 4)
      ) |>
        as_tibble()
    )
  )

fgsea_res <- fgsea_res_raw |>
  select(-gene_stats, -gs) |>
  unnest(res)

write_csv(
  fgsea_res,
  file.path(res_dir, "fgsea_cell_line_vs_other_lines.csv.gz")
)
```

```{r fgsea-heatmaps}
fgsea_heatmap_data <- fgsea_res |>
  filter(metric == "stat") |>
  group_by(gs_collection_id, line_type, pathway) |>
  filter(any(padj < 0.05)) |>
  mutate(min_padj = min(padj)) |>
  group_by(gs_collection_id, line_type) |>
  # Keep the 40 most significant sets per collection and line type
  filter(dense_rank(min_padj) <= 40) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      padj < 0.01 ~ "**",
      padj < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

fgsea_heatmaps <- fgsea_heatmap_data |>
  group_nest(gs_collection_id, line_type, keep = TRUE) |>
  filter(map_int(data, \(d) n_distinct(d$pathway)) > 1) |>
  mutate(
    p = pmap(
      list(data, gs_collection_id, line_type),
      \(df, coll, lt) {
        df_clust <- cluster_df(df, pathway, cell_line, NES)
        lim <- max(abs(df_clust$NES), na.rm = TRUE)
        ggplot(df_clust, aes(x = cell_line, y = pathway, fill = NES)) +
          geom_tile() +
          geom_text(aes(label = signif), vjust = 0.75) +
          scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", limits = c(-lim, lim)) +
          labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = paste(lt, coll, sep = " - ")) +
          theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
      }
    )
  )

pwalk(
  fgsea_heatmaps,
  \(gs_collection_id, line_type, data, p, ...) {
    ggsave(
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0("fgsea_heatmap_", make_clean_names(line_type), "_", make_clean_names(gs_collection_id), ".pdf")
      ),
      p,
      width = 4 + 0.4 * n_distinct(data$cell_line),
      height = 2 + 0.15 * n_distinct(data$pathway),
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
  }
)
```
